**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 4 (Syntax) is in progress: "Start here", the Basics, "Values and types", Operators and Control flow pages are written.**

`tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` `syntaxProblems` is the `syntax` part, tested in `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. Every Syntax page except `syntax/index.mdx` needs a non-empty `covers:`, a `<Snippet>` and a `## Do and don't` list.

On disk: `website/src/content/docs/syntax/start-here.mdx`, `syntax/basics/*.mdx`, `syntax/values/*.mdx`, `syntax/operators/*.mdx` and `syntax/control-flow/{if,match,switch,loops,foreach,iterators,break-continue-return,other-statements}.mdx`. Snippets sit flat under `website/snippets/syntax/<page>/`, with no section level. Sidebar entries are in `website/astro.config.ts`, stamps in `website/site.lock.json` (`bun nv site --stamp <page>...`). A front-matter value with `: ` in it must be quoted, or `covers:` reads as missing.

`site structure`, `stale` and `reference` pass. `site syntax` reports 86 uncovered features. Ids already assigned to later pages: `lang:types/callable-classes-object-shapes`, `lang:types/properties-and-constants`, `lang:expressions/object-literals`, `Comparable`, `Stringable`, `Parses` and `PropertyObserver` go to Classes. `lang:types/parameters`, `lang:types/void-never-self-static`, `lang:expressions/calls` and `lang:expressions/closures-fn` go to Functions. `lang:expressions/is-new-clone-throw-print-exit-isset-empty` goes to Classes (it covers `new` and `clone`). `lang:expressions/arrays-in-expressions` (destructuring) goes on `syntax/values/arrays.mdx`. The Throwable tree and `lang:statements/{try-catch-finally,catch-as-an-expression,throw}` go to Errors. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on pages that stages 5 and 6 rewrite.

Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/30-expressions.md:383`, `website/astro.config.ts:165`
